links.comparator_used: Physicians from other institutions delineating contours manually without auto-segmented contours (not fully automatic segmentation without correction)
links.outcome: Inter-physician contouring heterogeneity and contouring time
links.effect: Auto-segmentation reduced heterogeneity and shortened contouring time by 30 min; median overall physician satisfaction 7/10; no auto-segmented contours had large, obvious errors
links.tradeoff: The authors note the model may not completely replace humans; stomach and duodenum DSCs were lower (0.67 and 0.73) and CTV DSCs were 0.75-0.80.
links.quote: Auto-segmentation reduced heterogeneity and shortened contouring time by 30 min among radiation oncologists from different institutions.

design_hint: clinician editing of auto-segmented contours (human review)
